csv.filename_description: Index daily OHLCV CSVs laid out as <root>/YYYY/MM/DD.MM.YYYY_complete_df_OHLCV.csv (three-level: year, month, then the dated CSV directly — no symbol directory). One file per trading day; the dataset is a single index series so there is no ASK/BID split. Required columns: timestamp, open, high, low, close, volume. An optional vwap column ships per row and is preserved through to the returned dataframe. The scanner aggregates all daily files into one entry and presents it with a synthetic display name shaped like <SYMBOL>_DDMONYYYY_DDMONYYYY_LAST_OHLCV.csv (this is what filename_pattern matches — the source files themselves stay as DD.MM.YYYY_complete_df_OHLCV.csv on disk). Symbol is derived from the root folder name (uppercased, non-alphanumerics replaced with underscore). Default root: D:\complete_df_yyyy.
